reviewer: Independent GPT-6.1 Sol combat quality agent

ratings.reason: A functioning, coherent short FPS arena with usable controls and a complete mission framework. Combat pressure is binary, the signature dash is not needed in the movement sample, enemy roles are visually indistinguishable, and recoveries/extraction lack a meaningful commitment phase. This is not a10/10 prototype or a production-ready AAA game.

methods: Real Chrome/Playwright WebGL browser at1440x900, normal deployment and movement controls, active enemies.
35-second movement-survival sample: repeat WASD square segments every2.5seconds, no firing and no Soul Shift. No teleport, enemy removal, resource modification or simulation stepping.
After movement, stand and aim/fire using mouse movement events toward instrumented visible target positions; normal LMB and R controls. No movement during this segment. The run ended on death.
Inspected actual survival and defeat screenshots, and read game/audio code to distinguish observed behavior from structural limitations.
Reviewed the existing normal-control full-mission run for mission-completion context; this agent did not complete a blind mission.

priorities.finding: Ordinary continuous movement preserved full health for35seconds without shooting or dashing, but stopping to aim led to defeat roughly4.4simulated seconds later. Pressure is binary rather than a readable series of decisions.
priorities.recommendation: Add directional threat/damage feedback and stronger enemy charge cues; reduce synchronized burst spikes. Improve aim tracking/limited velocity lead during windup, then visibly lock the final aim briefly before firing. Tune from stationary/moving/dashing comparisons rather than simply increasing all damage.
priorities.verification: Moving alone should not erase every threat; standing in exposed crossfire should remain dangerous, but there should be readable warnings and enough response time to use cover or dash.

priorities.finding: Code makes recovery instantaneous at2.8m and extraction instantaneous on arrival. Final reinforcements can spawn far behind a faster player. That weakens the promised final act.
priorities.recommendation: Add a short visible core recovery channel and an8-12second extraction hold with explicit progress, cancellation/resume rules and local flanking reinforcements. Keep Recon forgiving. Do not require killing an arbitrary last enemy that may be stuck.
priorities.verification: A normal-control mission should contain at least one consequential defend-or-reposition choice during recovery and an understandable final extraction challenge.

priorities.finding: Both behavior profiles clone the same Blender drone. The fallback armor color difference is hidden when the authored model loads. A player cannot visually read which target will rush closer or fire faster.
priorities.recommendation: Give stalkers distinct silhouette/size, emissive accent, movement posture and charge cue. Use a more distant ranged role to create prioritization. Ensure the critical optic remains consistent with hit geometry.
priorities.verification: At normal encounter distance, the player should distinguish a close-pressure stalker from a ranged sentinel before it attacks.

priorities.finding: Every kill grants24rounds while only2-3hits are needed, each core grants60rounds/fullshield/30health, and shields regenerate. Multiple generous systems reduce route/target/resource tradeoffs.
priorities.recommendation: Reduce Standard recovery rewards or supply frequency and tie a clear reward to timed Soul Shift/critical streaks. Preserve a forgiving Recon option; do not make ammunition starvation a softlock.
priorities.verification: The player should choose reload and recovery moments under pressure while retaining a reliable route back from a poor encounter.

limits: Automated agent review with instrumented exact target positions is not human audience feedback.
No audio listening assessment was made; headless browser audio and source review do not establish sound quality.
Mission-pacing assessment combines structural code inspection and a prior full-run record; this agent's own normal-control run did not recover cores.
No hardware performance or broad accessibility certification is implied.
Ratings are candid provisional judgments, not an instruction to inflate the next score to10.
